about.title: Strength & Conditioning Coach
about.bio: I work with athletes across all sports to build the physical foundation that makes everything else possible — strength, power, speed, and resilience. My programming is evidence-based, position-specific, and designed to peak athletes at exactly the right time.

hero.headline: Build Strength. Perform Better.
hero.subline: Professional strength and conditioning — periodized programming, power development, and sport-specific training for athletes who want to dominate their season.

packages.title: Athletic Performance Block
packages.description: 8-week structured strength and power block — 3 sessions per week, movement screening, baseline testing, and progressive overload programming tailored to your sport.

packages.title: Off-Season Training
packages.description: Complete off-season development program — strength foundation, power conversion, and speed integration built to peak for fall or spring season. Includes body composition tracking.

packages.title: In-Season Maintenance
packages.description: 2 sessions per week during your competitive season — designed to maintain strength and power gains without compromising recovery or on-field performance.

success_stories.story: Marcus was strong but undertrained — his power output didn't match his size. We ran a 16-week off-season block focused on posterior chain strength and rate of force development.

faq.question: What sports do you train athletes from?
faq.answer: All sports — football, soccer, basketball, baseball, volleyball, track, swimming, and more. Programming is always sport-specific.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Sessions take place at a fully equipped training facility. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: Is this appropriate for younger high school athletes?
faq.answer: Yes — I work with high school athletes starting at 14. Programs are age-appropriate with proper load management and movement quality emphasis.

faq.question: Do you work alongside sport coaches?
faq.answer: Yes — I coordinate with sport coaches on scheduling and training load. The goal is to complement sport practice, not compete with it.

faq.question: What's included in the initial assessment?
faq.answer: Movement screening, strength baselines, power testing, and a review of your sport calendar and goals to build the right program.
